methodologyNotes: Specs sourced from official manufacturer spec pages (Apple Support, Samsung newsroom, Microsoft Learn, OnePlus, Lenovo), Wikipedia, and reputable launch coverage (Android Authority, Tom's Guide, PhoneArena, 9to5Google, Engadget, Windows Central). Numbers are stored unit-free; units implied by key name (display_in = diagonal inches, refresh_hz = Hz, ram_gb = GB, storage_gb = base config GB, battery_mah = mAh, weight_g = grams). battery_mah for Apple products is converted from official Wh at 3.82V nominal (38.99Wh → 10207mAh for iPad Pro M5 13, 36.59Wh → 9579mAh for iPad Air M4 13, 28.93Wh → 7575mAh for iPad 11 A16) — Apple's official pages report Wh only; mAh estimates are flagged in provenance. storage_gb is the lowest announced base config globally; priceUsd is the US launch MSRP for that base config. For Surface Pro 11, the base consumer Snapdragon X Plus model with IPS display at $999 is used as reference. OS is the version at launch. A null beats any guess; priceUsd=null only where no US MSRP exists. accessedAt is 2026-06-15 on every source.

products.name: Apple iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)

specs.stylus_support: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil USB-C

products.provenance: Specs from Apple's official tech specs page (support.apple.com/en-us/125407) and corroborated by Wikipedia and Apple newsroom (apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-introduces-the-powerful-new-ipad-pro-with-the-m5-chip/). Released October 22, 2025 (announced October 15). Display is Tandem OLED at 2752x2064, 264 ppi, ProMotion 10-120Hz. M5 chip; base 256GB has 12GB RAM; 1TB/2TB configs have 16GB RAM. Battery stated as 38.99Wh; mAh ~10207 at 3.82V nominal — Apple does not publish mAh officially. Weight 579g Wi-Fi, 582g cellular. $1299 US MSRP confirmed via Apple Store buy page. OS shown as iPadOS 26/19; launch OS inferred as iPadOS 19 (post-cutoff). Cellular models support 5G.

products.name: Apple iPad Air 13-inch (M4)

specs.stylus_support: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil USB-C

products.provenance: Specs from Apple's official tech specs page (support.apple.com/en-us/126472) and Apple newsroom (apple.com/newsroom/2026/03/apple-introduces-the-new-ipad-air-powered-by-m4/). Released March 11, 2026 (announced March 2). Display is IPS LCD Liquid Retina at 2732x2048, 264 ppi; refresh rate is 60Hz (no ProMotion on Air). All configurations include 12GB unified memory. Battery stated as 36.59Wh; mAh corrected to 9705 (authoritative figure cited by GSMArena/PhoneArena/Macworld and devicespecifications); the prior 9579 was a self-derived 3.82V conversion and is superseded. Weight 616g Wi-Fi, 617g cellular. $799 US MSRP (128GB Wi-Fi) confirmed via Apple Store. Cellular models support 5G. The Apple.com spec page currently shows M4 iPad Air (2026) as the current Air.

products.name: Apple iPad 11-inch (A16)

specs.stylus_support: Apple Pencil USB-C, Apple Pencil 1st gen (adapter)

products.provenance: Specs from Apple's official specs page (apple.com/ipad-11/specs/) fetched directly and Wikipedia. Released March 12, 2025 (announced March 4). Display is IPS LCD at 2360x1640, 264 ppi, 60Hz (no ProMotion). Apple A16 with 5-core CPU, 4-core GPU; 6GB RAM confirmed by PhoneArena review and Wikipedia (not listed on Apple's spec page). Battery 28.93Wh official; mAh ~7575 at 3.82V — Apple publishes Wh only; PhoneArena reports approximately 7600mAh. Marketed as '11-inch' but actual diagonal is 10.86 inches per spec page. Weight 477g Wi-Fi, 481g cellular. $349 US MSRP (128GB Wi-Fi) confirmed via Apple Store. Cellular models support 5G sub-6GHz.

products.name: Apple iPad mini (A17 Pro)

specs.stylus_support: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil USB-C

products.provenance: Specs from Apple's official tech specs page and confirmed by Wikipedia and PhoneArena. Released October 23, 2024. Display is IPS LCD at 2266x1488, 326 ppi, capped at 60Hz. A17 Pro (same chip as iPhone 15 Pro) with 8GB RAM. Battery 5078mAh per PhoneArena; Apple publishes only 19.3Wh (~5052mAh at 3.82V); using PhoneArena's measured figure. Weight 297g (lightest tablet in lineup). $499 US MSRP (128GB Wi-Fi). Cellular models support 5G. Apple Pencil Pro support is new for the mini 7th gen.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra
products.provenance: Specs from Wikipedia Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 article and corroborated by Android Authority launch coverage. Announced September 26, 2024; released October 3, 2024. Display is 14.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X at 2960x1848, 120Hz, HDR10+. Dimensity 9300+ (4nm). Base config 256GB/12GB; 16GB/512GB and 16GB/1TB also sold. Battery 11200mAh. Weight 718g Wi-Fi, 723g 5G. S Pen included and IP68 rated. 5G model available. US launch price $1199.99 (256GB) per Android Authority and PhoneArena launch coverage. OS at launch: Android 14 with One UI 6.1.1.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S10+
products.provenance: Specs from Wikipedia Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 article and corroborated by Android Authority and droid-life launch coverage. Released October 3, 2024. Display is 12.4-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X at 2800x1752, 120Hz. Dimensity 9300+ (4nm); 12GB RAM. Battery 10090mAh; 45W fast charging. Weight 571g Wi-Fi, 576g 5G. S Pen included, IP68. US launch price $999.99 per droid-life/Android Authority coverage. Note: Samsung dropped the base Tab S10 model — the S10 series only includes S10+, S10 Ultra, S10 FE, and S10 FE+.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 FE
products.provenance: Specs from Samsung US product page and Wikipedia Galaxy Tab S10 article; corroborated by 9to5Google and Samsung newsroom (news.samsung.com/us/galaxy-tab-s10-fe-series). Released April 10, 2025. Display is 10.9-inch IPS LCD (Samsung calls it Super PLS TFT) at 90Hz. Exynos 1580 chipset. Base config 128GB/8GB; 256GB/12GB also available. Battery 8000mAh. Weight 497g Wi-Fi, 500g 5G. S Pen included; IP68. 5G model at $599.99. Original US launch price $499.99 (128GB) confirmed by 9to5Google and Samsung newsroom. OS Android 15 with One UI 7 at launch per Samsung newsroom.

products.name: Microsoft Surface Pro 11th Edition
products.priceNote: MSRP, Snapdragon X Plus, 16GB/256GB, IPS, device only
products.provenance: Specs from Wikipedia Surface Pro (11th generation) article fetched directly, corroborated by Microsoft Learn tech specs page and Windows Central review. Released June 18, 2024 (consumer). Base consumer model uses Snapdragon X Plus (10-core); higher configs use Snapdragon X Elite (12-core) with optional OLED display. Display is 13-inch IPS at 2880x1920, 266 ppi, 120Hz for base model; OLED variant starts at $1499. Battery: IPS model 48Wh (~12565mAh at 3.82V); OLED model 53Wh. Weight 895g (Wikipedia). Consumer models are Wi-Fi only; 5G cellular only available on business/enterprise models. Surface Slim Pen 2 sold separately (not included). $999 US MSRP for base Snapdragon X Plus 16GB/256GB IPS model. RAM starts at 16GB (no 8GB option). cellular=false reflects consumer Wi-Fi-only base config.

products.name: Lenovo Tab Plus
products.provenance: Specs from WebSearch results citing Lenovo official page, Amazon listing, Notebookcheck review, and PhoneArena. Released June 20, 2024. Display is 11.5-inch IPS LCD at 2000x1200 (2K), 90Hz, 400 nits. MediaTek Helio G99. 8GB RAM, 128GB storage; microSD expandable. Battery 8600mAh with 45W charging. Weight 650g. Eight JBL speakers with Dolby Atmos — key differentiator. Wi-Fi only (no cellular option for the 2024 Tab Plus; the 'Lenovo Idea Tab Plus 5G' released 2025 is a separate model). Stylus: Lenovo Tab Pen Plus available separately (4096 pressure levels). $289.99 US MSRP confirmed by multiple US retail listings and PhoneArena news coverage. Android 14 at launch. Note: there is no cellular option on this model.

products.name: OnePlus Pad 2
products.provenance: Specs from OnePlus official US specs page (fetched directly) and Wikipedia OnePlus Pad 2 article. Available in US from July 30, 2024 (pre-orders July 16). Display is 12.1-inch IPS LCD at 3000x2120 (~303 ppi), 144Hz, Dolby Vision, 900 nits peak. Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 (Adreno 750). US sold only in 12GB/256GB config at $549.99 (globally also 8GB/128GB). Battery 9510mAh (36.99Wh per OnePlus specs) with 67W SUPERVOOC. Weight 584g. Wi-Fi only — no cellular option on Pad 2. Stylus is OnePlus Stylo 2 ($99, sold separately); supports 16,000 pressure levels. OxygenOS 14.1 on Android 14. $549.99 confirmed by OnePlus.com and Android Authority launch coverage.

products.name: Apple iPad Pro 11-inch (M5)

specs.stylus_support: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil USB-C

products.provenance: Specs from Apple's official tech specs page for 11-inch iPad Pro M5 and PhoneArena comparison. Released October 22, 2025 alongside the 13-inch model. Display is 11-inch Tandem OLED at 2420x1668, 264 ppi, ProMotion 10-120Hz. M5 chip; 12GB RAM for 256GB/512GB configs, 16GB for 1TB/2TB. Battery 31.29Wh (Apple official for 11-inch M5); mAh corrected to 8160 (GSMArena/PhoneArena) — the prior 7538/'~28.8Wh' figure was wrong. Weight 444g Wi-Fi, 446g cellular. $999 US MSRP (256GB Wi-Fi). Cellular models support 5G.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 FE+
products.provenance: Specs from Samsung US product page and 9to5Google launch coverage. Released April 10, 2025. Display is 13.1-inch IPS LCD at 2880x1800, 90Hz. Same Exynos 1580 chipset as Tab S10 FE. 128GB/8GB base. Battery 10090mAh per Samsung spec data. S Pen included. Wi-Fi 6 only (no cellular option per Samsung US). Weight corrected to 664g (Wi-Fi) per GSMArena/PhoneArena/devicespecifications (was null). US launch price corrected to $649.99 (128GB Wi-Fi) per 9to5Google launch coverage and Samsung US store; the prior $579.99 was wrong (contradicted by the cited 9to5Google source). OS Android 15 / One UI 7 at launch.

products.name: Apple iPad Air 11-inch (M4)

specs.stylus_support: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil USB-C

products.provenance: Specs from Apple's official iPad Air specs page (support.apple.com/en-us/126472 covers both sizes) and PhoneArena. Released March 11, 2026. Display is 11-inch IPS LCD Liquid Retina at 2360x1640, 264 ppi, 60Hz (no ProMotion). M4 chip with 12GB unified memory across all configs. Battery 28.93Wh (7606mAh per GSMArena/PhoneArena/devicespecifications); the prior 7538/'~28.8Wh' figure was wrong. Weight corrected to 464g Wi-Fi (465g cellular). $599 US MSRP (128GB Wi-Fi) per Apple Store. Cellular models support 5G.
